prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a low-speed head-on collision claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1135; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a low-speed head-on collision reported by the insured. Insured states the other vehicle crossed the centerline on a curve. No airbag deployment reported. Both vehicles driven from scene. Photos requested from insured and scene location noted. Claimant identified as the driver of the other vehicle and reports neck strain. Claimant is represented by counsel; all further contact to be routed through attorney's office.

Entry 2: Received letter of representation from claimant's attorney. Requested medical records and authorization for release of records through counsel. Attorney confirms claimant sought evaluation at urgent care the day after the collision and was diagnosed with cervical strain. Reserve adjusted to reflect bodily injury exposure. Liability under review pending police report and vehicle damage appraisal.

Entry 3: Police report obtained. Responding officer documented a minor front-end impact at low speed and noted the other driver's statement that they were avoiding debris. Witness statement from a passenger in the insured vehicle is consistent with the insured's account. Liability position still under evaluation. Property damage estimate received from the body shop and reviewed against the photos on file.

Entry 4: Spoke with claimant's attorney regarding the status of medical documentation. Attorney indicates treatment is ongoing with a physical therapist and that the claimant has missed some work. Requested updated treatment notes and wage verification. Attorney requested a prompt response on the bodily injury evaluation. Noted that a recorded statement from the claimant has not been taken, and that the request was declined through counsel.

Entry 5: Reviewed medical file received from claimant's provider. Records support a diagnosis of cervical strain with conservative treatment only and no imaging findings of fracture or disc injury. File referred to supervisor for evaluation of the bodily injury claim. Follow-up scheduled to confirm receipt of wage documentation from counsel. Claim remains open pending supervisor review.
